veranderings.voor: soos Ra die songod en Anubis
veranderings.na: soos die songod Ra en Anubis
veranderings.rede: 'Ra die songod' is an apposition without its commas, unlike 'Anubis, die god van mummifisering'; putting the title first is natural and needs no extra commas before 'en'.

veranderings.blok: Leer by die huis en op skool
veranderings.rede: 'Skoolgaan' is one verb (AWS), so its past participle is written 'skoolgegaan'; 'Net sommige kinders' and 'veral uit ryk families' stay untouched.

veranderings.na: bordspeletjies, net soos die antieke Egiptenare
veranderings.rede: 'bordspeletjies soos die Egiptenare' can be misread as 'board games such as the Egyptians'; 'net soos' with a comma makes the comparison cover both clauses, and 'antieke' separates them from Egyptians today in a then-and-now block.

vlae.teks: Vis uit die Nyl was vir hulle belangrik.
vlae.rede: 'hulle' could refer to the farmer's family or to both the farmer's family and the rich family in the previous sentence; naming the intended group would mean guessing the content, so the writer should decide.
